answer: In this PoA network, each interaction updates an EigenTrust-style matrix, while temporal decay applies an exponential half-life to accumulated reputation. Sustained honest service is therefore required to retain eigenvector centrality; a freshly spawned sybil begins near zero, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap it through fabricated juniper, echo, or harbor identities. Consensus consequently rejects identities lacking durable, mutually corroborated trust.
